title: Warm Worty Indian Milk Puffed Whole Milk Pancake
description: A malty, juicy, nostalgic Indian dish from the state of Rajasthan, made with whole milk, ferment-jang, and a Jain-friendly form of dosa.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the ferment-jang and sugar, and mix well.
Add the rice flour and salt to the bowl, and mix until well combined.
Gradually add the whole milk to the bowl, mixing continuously until a smooth batter forms.
Cover the bowl with a cloth and let it rest in a warm place for 2 hours.
After 2 hours, add the ghee and water to the bowl, and mix well.
Heat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
Using a ladle, pour a small amount of the batter onto the pan and spread it evenly to form a dosa.
Cook the dosa for 1-2 minutes, until it starts to bubble and the edges start to curl.
Loosen the dosa with a spatula and flip it over to cook the other side.
Cook for another 1-2 minutes, until the other side is golden brown.
Serve the warm worty Indian milk puffed whole milk pancake hot, garnished with chopped pistachios if desired.
